newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philodrill, Dragon get exploration contracts.
newsitem.headline: Philodrill, Dragon get exploration contracts.

text.p: The Philippines approved on Monday the exploration contracts of two consortia, one led by Dragon (Far East) Ltd of United Kingdom and another by Philodrill Corp, a statement from the presidential palace said.

The geophysical survey and exploration contract (GSEC) awarded to Dragon-led consortium will allow the group to explore for oil in 1.46 million hectares of offshore area in Mindoro, in central Philippines.
The Philodrill-led group, on the other hand, will explore for oil in a 455,000 hectare offshore area in Northwest Malampaya in southwestern Philippines.

Under the GSEC, the contractor is required to drill one well for the first 18 months of the contract. The group is also given the option to drill two option wells and to carry out a seismic survey programme.
